title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Lithuania
notice: 1 EUR ≈ 120 BDT (2026). Lithuania has no Embassy in Bangladesh — nearest Lithuanian Embassy is in New Delhi, India. Apply via VFS Global Dhaka or in person at the Embassy in Delhi.

processSteps.label: University Application : via admissions.lt or university portal
bullets: admissions.lt covers most major Lithuanian universities
Application window: March–June for September intake
Many programs have no application fee; some charge €20–30

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: English-taught programs: tuition €1,500–€6,000/year (1.8–7.2 Lac BDT)
Lithuanian Government Scholarship can waive tuition fees entirely
Confirm exact tuition fee before accepting the offer

processSteps.label: Prepare Financial Proof : ~€4,800–€8,000 (~5.8–9.6 Lac BDT) in bank
bullets: Minimum requirement: €400/month (~48,000 BDT)
Showing more (€6,000–€8,000) is recommended for a stronger application
Bank statement must clearly show your name and current balance

processSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: University dormitory: €100–€200/month (~12,000–24,000 BDT) — very affordable
Contact International Office immediately after receiving admission
Housing confirmation required for visa application

processSteps.label: Arrange Health Insurance
bullets: Mandatory for visa application
Must cover entire study period in Lithuania
Private insurance: ~€100–€300/year (~12,000–36,000 BDT)

processSteps.label: Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi / VFS Global — National D Visa Application
bullets: No Lithuanian Embassy in Bangladesh — apply via Embassy in New Delhi, India
VFS Global Dhaka may accept documents for forwarding — check current procedure
Visa fee: €80 (~9,600 BDT)
Processing time: 4–8 weeks

processSteps.label: Arrive in Lithuania — Register for Temporary Residence Permit
bullets: Within 30 days of arrival, register at Migration Department (Migracijos departamentas)
Apply for Temporary Residence Permit (Leidimas laikinai gyventi) for the duration of your studies
Obtain Lithuanian personal code (asmens kodas) for banking and work

costSteps.label: Lithuanian National D Visa Fee : €80 (~9,600 BDT) — paid at Embassy or VFS
Financial Proof in Bank : ~€4,800–€8,000 (~5.8–9.6 Lac BDT) — your own money, not a fee
University Application Fee : €0–30 depending on university (~0–3,600 BDT)
Air Ticket to Lithuania : ~60,000–80,000 BDT (via connection through Istanbul or Frankfurt)
